title: Card Tenure Rate Cut on Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Cash-Outs
content:
Holding a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card lowers the instant fee rate on cash-outs from the Pocketwire Personal Account, and more so for a card held longer.

> The card-tenure rate cut of the instant fee rate reads the customer's Pocketwire debit card: for a card in active or locked status activated at least 180 calendar days before the handling date the cut is 0.25 percentage points; for a card in active or locked status activated more recently it is 0.10 percentage points; with no such card it is 0.

**Input — judgement — output**

- *Input:* the status of the customer's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card and its activation date.
- *Judgement:* is the card in active or locked status? If so, how many calendar days lie between its activation date and the handling date? A card in active or locked status with no activation date recorded counts as activated more recently than 180 days.
- *Output:* 180 days or more: a cut of 0.25 percentage points; fewer than 180 days: 0.10 percentage points; no card in active or locked status: 0.

**Boundary pair (hypothetical):** a locked card activated 179 days before the handling date gives 0.10; one activated 180 days before gives 0.25. A card in any status other than active or locked gives 0.
